g.text: 1. Comm engine resources include threads and CCU instances.
2. Comm algorithms consist of Executors and Templates.
3. Base Comm primitives: CPU may be a general CPU or NPU AICPU; TS is the NPU task scheduler; AIV uses AscendC APIs,
but has no data-plane interface, so it is not shown here.
4. The notify mechanism exists in Channels and engine Threads.
5. Coll comm resource management is local or remote.
